data.title: 圣路易斯 · 街角咖啡馆的甜点投喂
data.description: 梧桐树荫下的欧式街角露天咖啡馆，微风徐徐。圣路易斯优雅地撑着下巴，用小银叉叉起一小块草莓蛋糕轻送到你唇边，歪着头带着调皮的笑意注视着你。
data.location: chic Parisian-style sidewalk cafe in the afternoon
data.action: sitting at outdoor cafe table shaded by awning, feeding a piece of strawberry cake with a small fork, playful loving smile
data.lighting: pleasant dappled afternoon sunlight filtered through leafy trees
data.mood: sweet romantic leisure, playful domestic indulgence, European charm
data.promptProse: Sitting at a chic outdoor cafe terrace in afternoon sun, St. Louis playfully feeds a bite of strawberry cake to her partner with a fond smile.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis feeding a bite of cake at a sunny sidewalk cafe.
